note: Provisional two-player rules, to be replaced with the structure captured from the original (#22). Running Events: both players race side by side in these lanes, with no Rival. Field Events: 'alternate' takes turns Attempt by Attempt; 'consecutive' lets each player take all their Attempts in turn. A player who misses a Standard is out; 'allOut' ends the Session once every player is out, 'anyOut' as soon as one is. Points and High Score entries are always per player.
